exposure: support of the husband and best friends for breastfeeding
a previous successful breastfeeding experience ≥6 months
formal employment with ≥6 months of paid maternity leave
Infants under 6 months of age (breastfed vs. non-breastfed)
Breastfeeding support from family, friends, and workplace
outcome: Reasons for non-commencement or early cessation of breastfeeding
cohort: 5237 infants under 6 months of age in China
finding: The exclusive breastfeeding rate in China was found to be low (30%), with various factors influencing it, including maternal education, employment status, support systems, breastfeeding knowledge and experience, caesarean delivery, and infant health.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding.
